note: Example only. User-Agent matching is spoofable and must not be treated as strong identity.

rules.name: Scanner User-Agent example
rules.expression: (not cf.client.bot and (http.user_agent eq "" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "sqlmap" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "nikto" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "nuclei" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "wpscan"))
